# Federated Learning & Privacy-Preserving ML

**Train models without collecting the data: federated averaging, Flower simulations, differential privacy, secure aggregation, encryption, and the attacks these defend against.**

Level: **Advanced** · 12 steps · 3h 26m of video · Prerequisites: [Deep Learning](deep-learning.md) (PyTorch training loops). Basic probability from [Python & Math for AI](foundations.md) helps for the differential privacy steps.

## Build it

- Simulate 10 Flower clients on CIFAR-10, split the data so each client sees only two classes, and compare accuracy with centralized training.
- Train an MNIST model with and without DP-SGD using Opacus and plot accuracy against the privacy budget epsilon.
- Run a simple loss-threshold membership inference attack on an overfit model and on a regularized one, and compare how often it succeeds.
